versions.description_html:
Learn how Azure Migrate works for cloud migration. Discover server assessment, dependency analysis, agentless setup, and cost optimization.

Azure Migrate is free, and it will tell you what your own servers are really costing you. That sounds simple, but the hard part of a migration usually happens before anyone opens the cloud portal, because nobody mapped what was connected to what.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Azure Migrate Actually Is
  • How Discovery Works
  • The Assessment: Readiness, Sizing, Cost
  • Dependency Analysis
  • Agentless or Agent-Based
  • Moving in Waves
  • The Hub and Its Tools
  • The Pitfalls to Avoid
  • The Recap

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Migrate Exchange Web Services to Microsoft Graph with Glen Scales [MVP]
  • Migrate Bing Maps to Azure Maps in Power BI
  • More Cloud Architecture episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Azure & Cloud: the most-listened episodes
